name: Erxiang Jing
source:
In the year 2050, in the tech metropolis of [b]Lindu[/b], breakthroughs in spacetime technology have been achieved—but with them, a surge in high-tech crime. You will play as a spacetime researcher in the future, navigating your daily life and work at the Spacetime Research Institute. Along the way, you will encounter bizarre anomalies, relive mysterious cycles, forge connections with diverse characters, and uncover the truth behind these abnormal events—no matter the cost…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5093870]Steam[/url]]
